steps: Unplug the machine and wait 30 seconds
Flip the machine onto a folded towel
Remove the two clips on the bottom panel
Inspect the brewing chamber gasket for cracks
Replace the gasket if damaged
Reassemble and run a clean cycle
Fill reservoir with 1:1 vinegar and water
Place large mug on drip tray
Lift and lower handle, then press brew button
Repeat until reservoir is empty
Run three cycles of fresh water to rinse
Hold brew and 10oz buttons for 3s to reset light

symptom: milk wand not steaming or clogged
steps: Use the cleaning tool tip to clear the wand hole
Remove the wand tip using the tool's wrench
Soak tip in hot water with cleaning powder
Purge the steam wand without the tip
Reinstall the tip and tighten firmly
Test steam output into a pitcher

symptom: lid won't seal or steam leaking
steps: Check the silicone sealing ring for cracks
Ensure the ring is seated firmly behind the rack
Clean the float valve and its silicone cap
Inspect the steam release handle for debris
Close lid and ensure it clicks into place
Perform a 2-minute water test to confirm seal
